received_works.body:
I’d like to commission an illustration of my characters.
They are the adventurers from CoCTRPG, specifically the characters from Shiroha-san’s scenario titled “The Fall of Love: Rotka Volterra.”
I’d be delighted if you could draw an interaction scene based on Senkan-san’s interpretation.
Once I receive the artwork, I plan to share it with the people I played with,
as well as enjoy it privately.


Below is the link to the shared folder containing the character designs.
Please take a look.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IwmYfNs2x8T5DOgazrdEc5v8IHKBbahe?usp=sharing
There are multiple files in the folder, but please refer to "Rotoada_Display" for the basic appearance.
I’ve included the other files as references in case any information is missing.

Also, regarding the character information below,
you don’t need to read it if it’s not necessary.
However, if you are unsure about composition or structure, I would appreciate it if you could take a look.


[About the Characters]
◇HO1 Yakuza
Name: Kazuchi Ishitake Age: 35 Gender: Male
Height: 178 cm Hair Color: Reddish-brown (#a53107) Eye Color: Light blue (#62caf1)

Personality:
He isn’t the type to talk nonstop, but he’s quick to retort and gets into verbal spats.
He’s violent but not sadistic, so he doesn’t tend to enjoy one-sided beatings.
A lawless man who uses force to make money and get what he wants.

He’s loved rakugo since he was young and frequents traditional comedy theaters.
Perhaps because of this, his speech is slightly influenced by the Edo dialect.

Regarding HO2:
When they first met, he saw him as a cocky, annoying brat.
He had talent for rakugo, but his lack of substance and half-hearted attitude really got on his nerves.

Now, after some twists and turns, they are dating and planning to move in together.
He often gets called out by HO2 for making insensitive remarks when he’s in the dominant role.
(Such as actions or comments that hint at his past relationships with women)

He likes HO2’s voice and still frequents rakugo venues to enjoy the performances.


◇HO2 Rakugo Performer
Name: Tsuchigaya Natsume Age: 26 Gender: Male
Height: 159 cm Hair Color: Green Eye Color: Green (Image Color: #e0ffc1)

Personality:
He doesn’t understand human emotions and learned why people laugh, cry, and feel fear through rakugo.
He has a playful side but is generally detached; he can be rather cold toward people he isn’t close to.
He also has a competitive streak—he won’t back down in an argument and will even hit people with his iron fan.

He performs under the stage name Torakutei Hakusai.
He speaks with a brash, streetwise tone and has a quick tongue.

Regarding HO1:
When they first met, she disliked him because he was the only one who didn’t laugh at her performances.
It annoyed her that HO1 would come to listen even though he didn’t seem to find it funny, and she couldn’t stop thinking about him.

Currently, after many twists and turns, they are dating and plan to move in together.
Even when she calls HO1 out on his tactless remarks, she ultimately forgives him.
When HO1 asks about the drawbacks and resolve required to spend a lifetime with a yakuza,
he responds with words and actions that show he possesses the inner fortitude to remain unshaken to the core.

HO1 pointed out that he is afraid of interacting with people,
and upon learning that HO1 had always appreciated his rakugo, he developed feelings for him.


Thank you for reading this far.
I sincerely appreciate your support.

Mr. Senma, thank you for your continued support! I always enjoy seeing your wonderful illustrations on Twitter. This time, I'd like to request your artwork for the player characters (OCs) in the scenario "Witness of the Minotaur." Below is a brief description. For their appearances, I'll share reference materials via the URL below. ────

✦HO1-White Night 23 years old/APP7/SIZ14 The younger brother of the pair. Quick-witted and polite. Has a laid-back personality. Rarely takes center stage, but cares little about anything besides his brother. Revived his lost brother on his own. ────

✦HO2-Polar Night 25 years old/APP15/SIZ14 The older brother. Tolerant of himself and others, cheerful and often smiling. Behind his lighthearted demeanor lies a strong attachment to his family. Since being revived, he has been less patient with his younger brother. ────

Technically, they're brothers, but feel free to ignore that. Usage is limited to personal use only, like SNS icons. Thank you for your cooperation🦕🎶 https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1G1RN5Fbyy4oz6KNt9BNxEYdvx-78M5VY?usp=drive_link
